Nikki and Ollie speculate to accumulate in Moray, splashing out on a new honesty shack.

events.description: Kent couple Lou and Andy Webb have two young children affected by a rare genetic condition that severely restricts their eyesight, meaning they only see in black and white and have to wear special goggles in sunlight. Alan Titchmarsh's challenge is to create a more child-friendly garden for their terraced home in Tonbridge, and his first task is to make a shady environment so the kids can spend time outside in the day. After that, he and the team come up with a bespoke lighting system for the evenings, acoustic fencing to cut down the noise from a nearby railway line, and an area for the parents

events.description: Alan Titchmarsh and the horticultural experts come to the aid of Vicky and Simon Pyne, whose daughter Alice died of cancer in January 2013. The team plans to bring the best of the Cumbrian landscape to the Pynes' awkwardly shaped garden, complete with a refuge for their 14-year-old daughter Milly, who has faced her own health problems over the years

events.name: Garden Rescue
events.description: In Uttoxeter, east Staffordshire, Shail and Cecilia long for a garden that reminds them of growing up in the countryside of India. However, the new-build garden they own is a featureless sloping plot. Lee Burkhill and Flo Headlam pool their efforts to create an entertainment space in the middle of the garden with a central patio featuring bespoke screesn and L-shaped benches. Lee adds a home-made tandoor for the family to cook together and a food prep area and vegetable growing beds. Flo mucks in with a planting area to draw attention from the giant walls and herb garden by the back door

Lee Burkhill and Flo Headlam pool their efforts to create an entertainment space in the middle of the garden with a central patio featuring bespoke screesn and L-shaped benches. Flo mucks in with a planting area to draw attention from the giant walls and herb garden by the back door

event.name: Love Your Garden
event.description: The green-fingered team returns with more surprise garden makeovers for deserving people across the nation. Darren and Lesley Chan's youngest daughter Amelie was born with Charge syndrome - a debilitating genetic condition that has left her deaf, partially sighted and in need of constant care. Alan Titchmarsh sets out to transform the Manchester family's neglected outdoor space, calling in David Domoney, Frances Tophill and Katie Rushworth to introduce sensory planting for the 10-year-old, a shade-loving border and a multifunction pathway made from areas of decking, artificial turf and paving

event.name: Garden Rescue
event.description: Five years ago, the team turned Ian and Ruth's rural plot in Powys into a country garden in what was one of the series' most emotional reveals. Charlie Dimmock returns to discover the garden looking better than ever and see how Ian and his sons have been busy with new projects. Plus, a revisit to a garden in Shoreham, West Sussex, that went from mediocre to a Mediterranean marvel and a garden that turned a Stockport couple into 'lord and lady of the manor'

event.description: Alex creates a stir by broadcasting a book review show on Lochdubh's pirate radio station - but TV John senses a dark cloud is about to blot out the shining sun of literary appreciation.
